query:
SELECT c.mentor_id AS "mentor_id!", c.name AS "name!", c.at AS "at!: i64",
            c.unread AS "unread!", (
            SELECT subject
            FROM (
                SELECT subject, sent_at
                FROM email
                WHERE mentor_id = c.mentor_id AND state IN ('maybe_sent', 'sent',
                    'bounced')
                UNION ALL
                SELECT m.subject, m.sent_at
                FROM message m
                JOIN message_mentor mm ON mm.message_id = m.id
                WHERE mm.mentor_id = c.mentor_id AND m.kind <> 'auto_reply'
            )
            ORDER BY sent_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS "subject?: String"
        FROM (
            SELECT mc.mentor_id, m.name, mc.unread, max(coalesce(mc.last_out_at, 0),
                coalesce(mc.last_reply_at, 0)) AS at
            FROM mentor_contact mc
            JOIN mentor m ON m.id = mc.mentor_id
            WHERE m.trashed_at IS NULL AND (NOT ?1 OR mc.unread > 0)
            ORDER BY at DESC, mc.mentor_id DESC
            LIMIT ?2
            OFFSET ?3
        ) c
        ORDER BY c.at DESC, c.mentor_id DESC
